python3 - <<'PY'
import re, pathlib
s = pathlib.Path("crates/elephc-builtin-contract/src/catalog_data.rs").read_text()
# split into contracts
hits = []
for m in re.finditer(r'name: "([a-z0-9_]+)",\n\s+area:', s):
    pass
blocks = s.split("BuiltinContract {")
for b in blocks[1:]:
    nm = re.search(r'name: "([^"]+)"', b)
    if not nm: continue
    for pm in re.finditer(r'ParamSpec \{\s*name: "([^"]+)",\s*ty: ([^,]+),\s*default: ([^\n]+),\s*by_ref: (true|false),', b):
        if pm.group(4) == "true":
            hits.append((nm.group(1), pm.group(1), pm.group(2).strip(), pm.group(3).strip().rstrip(",")))
ea = [h for h in hits if "EmptyArray" in h[3]]
print("by-ref params total:", len(hits))
print("with EmptyArray default:", len(ea))
for h in ea: print("  ", h)
